title: Researcher Output (v2.3, descriptive)
description: Final structured output of the Researcher agent — provides validated idea data for the Bundle Planner, including pricing, competition, and prioritization metrics.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp representing when this payload was generated.

ideas.description: List of evaluated digital product ideas, each containing descriptive, pricing, competition, and scoring data.

id.description: Unique identifier for this idea (e.g., UUID or timestamped ID).

title.description: Concise, human-readable title for the product concept.

niche.description: Primary market or topical category for this product idea.

sub_niche.description: Refined subcategory or specialization within the broader niche.

one_liner.description: Short marketing-friendly summary expressing what the product is and why it matters.

value_prop.description: Outcome-oriented description of the transformation or benefit the product delivers.

differentiation_angle.description: Key aspect or innovation that distinguishes this idea from existing market alternatives.

demand_signals.description: Observed phrases, listings, or data points that suggest active demand for this type of product.

suggested_price_band.description: Recommended pricing range for this idea based on perceived value and competitive positioning.

low.description: Lower boundary (USD) for the recommended sale price.

high.description: Upper boundary (USD) justified by feature completeness and perceived value.

pricing_observed.description: Observed price range (USD) for comparable existing products within the same niche.

low.description: Lower observed price in the current market.

median.description: Typical median price or midpoint of comparable offerings.

high.description: Highest observed price among comparable listings.

competition_density.description: Qualitative market saturation level: 'low' = blue ocean, 'saturated' = heavy competition.

competing_count.description: Approximate number of directly competing products observed during research.

reach.description: Estimated potential audience size (1 = narrow niche, 5 = mass-market).

impact.description: Expected value delivered per user (1 = minor improvement, 5 = major transformation).

confidence.description: Confidence (0–1) in the validity of assumptions based on supporting evidence.

effort.description: Relative difficulty or complexity of building this product (1 = easy, 5 = high effort).

roi_estimate.description: Preliminary ROI proxy, typically computed as (reach * impact * confidence) / effort.

priority.description: Priority tier for production: A = high-value opportunity, B = medium, C = low.

counterpoints.description: Identified risks, potential objections, or execution challenges for this idea.

why_now.description: Explanation of timing or trend alignment—why this opportunity is relevant now.
